content: {"question":"If I move from GitLab LTD (UK) to GitLab France S.A.S., how will my annual leave entitlement change in terms of total days and the way it is tracked?","answer":"I would go from 28 days total (20 days annual leave + 8 public holidays) tracked in Workday as Paid Time Off to a French statutory vacation plus additional RTT days, also tracked in Workday but with separate RTT tracking.","evidence_a":"28 days total (20 days annual leave + 8 public holidays) as per the statutory requirements","evidence_b":"Additional RTT days for work-life balance. Team members are responsible for ensuring that they are tracking their time accurately in Workday."}
